title: MARVEL: Multidimensional Abstraction and Reasoning through Visual Evaluation and Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the output distribution of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on multiple-choice abstract visual reasoning puzzles to identify severe imbalances, such as models consistently selecting a specific choice index (e.g., Choice 1 or Choice 4) irrespective of the visual input.

Comparing model performance across various multidimensional task configurations and input shapes to detect if models rely on familiar pre-training formats or shortcut learning rather than genuine abstract visual comprehension.
